GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When qst re her riding in particular the middle stages of the event App rdr std her instructions where to allow the gelding to travel tractably and at this stage of the event she felt that she had still maintained a competitive position at the rear of the field. After further scrutiny of the patrol films App rdr conceded that she had allowed her mount to become detached from the remainder of the field. App rdr was told in future she must ride her mnts more competitively to avoid her riding being queried. A post-race vet exam rev gelding to be lame (2/5) near-hind. Tnr advise V/C now required.
